### 步骤


#### 2. 确认 checkpoint 和模型
```bash

ls /root/autodl-tmp/models/LLM-Research/Meta-Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct-AWQ-INT4/ | head -5
```

#### 3. 查看之前 8B LoRA eval 脚本作为参考
```bash
find /root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie -name "run_constrained*" -type f | head -5
python3 run_constrained_extraction.py --help 2>/dev/null | head -30
```

#### 4. 运行推理
70B AWQ INT4 ~35-40GB VRAM，单卡 96GB 够用。用 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1。

**Unconstrained:**
```bash
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 python3 run_constrained_extraction.py \
  --mode unconstrained \
  --dataset docred \
  --model_path /root/autodl-tmp/models/LLM-Research/Meta-Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct-AWQ-INT4 \
  --lora_path /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/70b_lora_docred/checkpoint-1146 \
  --data_path data/docred/dev.json \
  --constraints_path data/docred/ontology_constraints_docred.json \
  --output_path /root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/r16_70b_lora_docred/docred_unconstrained.jsonl \
  --max_new_tokens 4096 \
  --seed 42
```

**Constrained (S1):**
```bash
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 python3 run_constrained_extraction.py \
  --mode full_s1 \
  --dataset docred \
  --model_path /root/autodl-tmp/models/LLM-Research/Meta-Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct-AWQ-INT4 \
  --lora_path /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/70b_lora_docred/checkpoint-1146 \
  --data_path data/docred/dev.json \
  --constraints_path data/docred/ontology_constraints_docred.json \
  --output_path /root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/r16_70b_lora_docred/docred_full_s1.jsonl \
  --max_new_tokens 4096 \
  --seed 42
```

注意：
- 如果脚本不支持 `--lora_path`，检查是否需要先 merge adapter
- 如果需要 merge，用 peft 合并：加载 base model + adapter → merge → save
- AWQ 模型加载时可能需要 monkey-patch：`import peft.import_utils as _piu; _piu.is_gptqmodel_available = lambda: False`
- DocRED 序列更长，可能需要更多 VRAM。如果 OOM，减小 batch_size 或加 `--max_samples 200` 先跑子集

#### 5. 提取结果
```bash
python3 check_violations.py --input /root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/r16_70b_lora_docred/docred_unconstrained.jsonl --dataset docred
python3 check_violations.py --input /root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/r16_70b_lora_docred/docred_full_s1.jsonl --dataset docred
```
